verdict.line: You lose if Darius hits level 3-5 with E up and 3+ Hemorrhage stacks before you can shield; you win every trade from level 6 on once Realm of Death takes him off the map.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser out-sustains Darius in every extended trade because W (Indestructible) converts incoming damage into healing while Darius has no comparable recovery outside his passive stacks. Darius's only real window is the pre-6 all-in once he has Q (Decimate), W (Crippling Strike), and E (Apprehend) online together — after that, Morde's wave clear, shield uptime, and R (Realm of Death) isolation flip the lane hard in his favor.

theirWindow.what: Do not stand in his E pull range or facetank autos to farm. Play from max Q (Obliterate) range on casters, let him hit minions for stacks instead of you, and hold W (Indestructible) rather than pre-shielding minions.

yourWindow.when: his E (Apprehend) is down or stacks reset to 0
yourWindow.what: Walk in and melee-range Q, then W to convert his return damage into healing. This is a free trade window — press it every time his E goes on cooldown, especially after he uses it to secure a wave.

start.why: The passive negates repeated poke from his auto-attack-based Hemorrhage stacking and lets you sit in CS range without bleeding HP.

boots.why: Flat armor plus the auto-attack damage reduction directly blunts his AA-reliant stack-and-slow trade pattern.

core.why: Health and armor to tank his all-in window, with passive burn that helps you win extended trades and clear waves fast.
The percent-max-health magic damage over time shreds his stacked HP and the omnivamp adds another layer of sustain on top of W.
Boosts every point of healing you're generating from W and Riftmaker, which is your entire win condition in this matchup.

situational.when: he is building crit or lethality and out-damaging your shield
he is fed and you need the active slow to stop him disengaging your R
he is somehow itemizing into lifesteal or grievous-wounds-immune healing

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the long, repeated trades this matchup is built around and gives permanent max-HP scaling that outlasts his burst window.

summoners.why: Standard top-lane macro — you win the lane by outlasting him and freezing waves, so TP lets you capitalize on side-lane pressure once you're ahead rather than forcing a kill you don't need.

playing.title: Play from melee range on cooldown, not on autos
playing.detail: Q (Obliterate) scales up hard the closer you are when it lands, so walk in, cast it point-blank, then disengage rather than trading autos at range where his passive stacks faster than your damage.

playing.title: Hold W until you're already taking damage
playing.detail: Indestructible's value is the shield-to-heal conversion, so pop it right as he commits to a trade, not preemptively while farming — wasted early casts give up your best sustain tool for the actual fight.

playing.title: Respect the level 3-5 all-in exactly once
playing.detail: Before you have R, a full Q-W-E-AA from him with 3+ stacks can genuinely hurt you. Play passive around his E cooldown in this window specifically, then stop respecting it once you hit 6.

playing.title: Ult him when he overextends alone
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) removes his teammates and traps his escape tools inside the arena with you — use it proactively on any overextension from level 6 on rather than saving it purely as a defensive panic button.

playing.title: Freeze the wave once you're level 6
playing.detail: Your clear with Q and passive is faster than his, so you can afford to freeze near your tower and force him to either match you in melee (where you win) or give up CS.

playing.title: Don't fight below 40% without W up
playing.detail: His passive execute-style true damage on 5 stacks and his ultimate's missing-health scaling both punish low-HP Morde hard — reset if your shield is down and you're under half health.

brief.patchCaveat: Item names, keystone values, and Darius's E/R numbers drift patch to patch — this is written from general knowledge and should be sanity-checked against the current 16.18.1 patch notes before locking in build order.
